verdict.rationale: Solid's own README directly claims it is "Web component friendly and can author custom elements" (solid-gh-7), so this is a first-party capability. However, that one-line claim is the only evidence: it gives no detail on the authoring API, Shadow DOM or attribute/property handling, or standards compliance, and no community or hands-on report confirms it. Missing for 10: documented custom-element authoring API/package, details on Shadow DOM and attribute/property reflection, independent or hands-on corroboration.
